newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ job ads show patchy recovery in Feb -- ANZ Bank.
newsitem.headline: NZ job ads show patchy recovery in Feb -- ANZ Bank.

text.p: The trend number of New Zealand job ads rose 0.5 percent in February on January, ANZ Bank said on Tuesday.
But in annual terms, February's figures were down 5.6 percent on February 1996.
The trend in job ads in Auckland and Christchurch rose further in February while falling in Wellington, although the decline in the capital appeared to be levelling out.
In Auckland, the job ads trend rose 0.4 percent in February after a 0.6 percent rise in January. In Christchurch the February rise was 2.2 percent and Wellington the fall was 0.9 percent.
ANZ economist Bernard Hodgetts said job ads in the smaller regions weakened in all areas in the first two months of 1997 against the year ago period.
